data.description:
The frontend's non-visual core: API types and client, URL state hook, search hook with abort and previous-results memory, cities hook, and the BRANDING formatters. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §7.1, §7.2, §7.3, §8 (frontend hooks and formatters). Design: BRANDING.md §7.1 formatting table.

Why: components (BC-9, BC-10, BC-11) must be pure props-in renderers; everything stateful and every string-formatting rule lives here with its own tests, so three component tasks can run in parallel.

Scope:
- src/api/types.ts exactly as §7.3. src/api/errors.ts with ApiError union and a `parseErrorResponse(res)` helper. src/api/client.ts: `searchListings(params, signal?)` builds the query string (undefined omitted, status repeated, numbers as plain strings), `getCities(signal?)`; non-2xx bodies parse into ApiError; fetch TypeError and AbortError map to kind 'network' (the hook ignores aborts).
- src/hooks/useSearchParamsState.ts per §7.1: parse window.location.search into SearchParams on mount (numbers parsed, invalid values dropped), `setSearch(next)` pushes the new query string without page, `setPage(n)` pushes with only page changed, `clear()` pushes an empty query, popstate re-reads; pageSize preserved if present.
- src/hooks/useListingSearch.ts per §7.2 returning SearchState; AbortController per request; previous data retained during loading and on invalid/error; the state 'empty' when totalItems is 0; 'invalid' for validation errors.
- src/hooks/useCities.ts: load once, return string[] (empty on failure, error to console.error).
- src/format/money.ts, date.ts, listing.ts implementing every row of BRANDING §7.1: price `$450,000`; `2 bd`; `1 ba` / `1.5 ba`; `1,450 sqft`; `Listed Aug 29` with `, YYYY` when not the current year (year injected for tests); source `MLS_A` to `MLS A`; status label uppercase only when not active; score two decimals; rank `No. 1`; `1 result` / `12 results`; `Page 1 of 2`; monogram initials `Sp`.
- Tests per §8: client query building and error parsing (400 validation with fields, 500 http, TypeError network, abort ignored); both hooks under jsdom with history and popstate; every formatter row.

Acceptance:
- All tests green; `make lint` green.
- No new runtime dependencies.
- Types compile against a fixture built from the real sample data (src/test/fixtures.ts with three listings and one full SearchResponse).

Validation: N/A until BC-12 wires a page. Record a one-line justification with --role validation and cite the test output.
data.title: Frontend core: API client and types, URL state and search hooks, BRANDING formatters

data.body: Plan-review triage (art_01M4W468FKGQZA6X41W7ZDMZGP, PASS, 8 minor): 7 obvious, amended in the plan's 'Plan-Review Cycle 1 Resolutions' block: R1 gate is full make check + npm run build, base master @83952b0 (BC-7 landed); R2 keep derived-loading design and document the A->B->A silent refetch in the SPEC 7.2 sentence plus a test; R3 SPEC edit also fixes the 7.2 success comment (page past end) and records clear() keeping pageSize in 7.1; R4 trim city/keyword, drop bad status values individually, unknown URL params dropped deliberately, plus tests; R6 ApiRequestError without parameter properties (erasableSyntaxOnly); R7 useRealTimers in afterEach, no items.length vs page assertions; R8 children add new format files and labelled fixture blocks. 1 skipped (evolutionary): R5 move serializer+parser to src/api/query.ts, because SPEC 3 enumerates src/api files and the gain is cosmetic. No complex findings.

SPEC deviation (in-branch, dc9a446, per SPEC's own deviation rule; clarifications, no type or API change): (1) SPEC 7.1: 'Clear writes an empty query string except for pageSize, which is preserved like everywhere else' replaces the contradictory 'Clear writes an empty query string' (pageSize preserved-if-present already applied). (2) SPEC 7.2 SearchState success comment: 'totalItems > 0; items may be empty on a page past the end' (was items.length > 0; 5.3 makes page-past-end a 200 with empty items). (3) SPEC 7.2 new sentence: useListingSearch returns { state, retry }; retry() re-runs the current params; params compared by serialized query; returning to a held query shows its result and refetches without a loading state; the hook logs http/network failures with the request ID (7.5) and callers do not log again. Plan-review R2/R3.

BC-8 shared frontend helpers: exports and usage notes for BC-9/10/11/12 (as implemented at 43e8824).

EXPORTS (frontend/src/)
api/types.ts: ListingStatus, SearchParams, ListingResult, PageMeta, ScoringMeta, SearchResponse, FieldError, ValidationError, ApiError (SPEC 7.3 verbatim); LISTING_STATUSES: readonly ['active','pending','sold']
api/errors.ts: type re-exports ApiError, FieldError, ValidationError; class ApiRequestError extends Error { readonly apiError: ApiError; readonly requestId: string | null }; parseErrorResponse(res: Response): Promise<ApiError>; toApiError(err: unknown): ApiError
api/client.ts: buildSearchQuery(params): string (canonical, no leading '?'); searchListings(params, signal?): Promise<SearchResponse>; searchListingsByQuery(query, signal?): Promise<SearchResponse>; getCities(signal?): Promise<string[]> (all reject with ApiRequestError)
hooks/useSearchParamsState.ts: parseSearchParams(search): SearchParams; useSearchParamsState(): { params; setSearch(next); setPage(n); clear() }
hooks/useListingSearch.ts: type SearchState (SPEC 7.2 as edited); useListingSearch(params): { state: SearchState; retry: () => void }
hooks/useCities.ts: useCities(): string[] ([] until loaded and on failure)
format/money.ts: formatWholeNumber(n) '1,450'; formatPrice(n) '$450,000'
format/date.ts: formatListedDate(iso, currentYear = local current year) 'Listed Aug 29' | 'Listed Aug 29, 2025'
format/listing.ts: META_SEPARATOR ' · '; formatBedrooms '2 bd'; formatBathrooms '1 ba'/'1.5 ba'; formatSqft '1,450 sqft'; formatSource 'MLS A'; formatStatusLabel(status) 'PENDING'|'SOLD'|null; formatLocation({city,state,zip}) 'Springfield, VA 22150'; formatListingMeta(item, year?) [location, bd, ba, sqft, listed, source]; formatScore '0.74'; formatRank 'No. 1'; formatMonogram 'Sp'; formatResultCount '1 result'/'12 results'/'0 results'; formatOrdering(budget|null) 'ranked for $450,000'|'newest first'; formatResultSummary(data) '12 results · ranked for $450,000'; formatPageOf(page, total) 'Page 1 of 2' ('' when total <= 0)
test/fixtures.ts: listingA1 (rank 1, Springfield), listingA3 (rank 4, Fairfax, '1 ba'), listingA7 (rank 10, Chantilly, pending): ListingResult; searchResponse (page 1 of the real targetBudget=450000 search), emptySearchResponse (city=Arlington): SearchResponse; cities; validationErrorBody, internalErrorBody: ErrorBody; jsonResponse(body, { status?, requestId? }): Response; deferred<T>(): Deferred<T>

USAGE NOTES
1. Do not fork helpers. Add new helpers in NEW files under src/format/ (e.g. BC-9 '$400,000' input parsing in format/input.ts) and add fixtures inside a labelled '// --- BC-N additions ---' block at the end of fixtures.ts, so parallel branches merge cleanly. Listed signatures are frozen; changing one is a SPEC-level change through the Orchestrator.
2. searchResponse carries 3 items under page { totalItems 12, totalPages 2 } (trimmed from the real page). Never assert items.length against page.*.
3. Components call formatListedDate / formatListingMeta without a year. Their tests pin the clock with vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'], now: new Date(2026, 9, 13) }) and call vi.useRealTimers() in afterEach (restoreMocks does not undo fake timers).
4. formatListingMeta excludes the status label; BC-10 renders formatStatusLabel(item.status) in Label style first when non-null, then the meta items joined by META_SEPARATOR.
5. BC-11 owns the SearchState -> StatusLine mapping: loading 'Loading'; success/empty formatResultSummary(data) and formatPageOf; invalid uses the previous response; error is empty.
6. BC-9: LISTING_STATUSES feeds the Status select; server FieldErrors arrive on state.error.fields when state.status === 'invalid'.
7. BC-12 (SearchPage): wire retry to ErrorState's Try again. The hook already console.errors http/network failures with the request ID; do not log again. Re-submitting identical filters does not refetch (use retry). Returning to a query the hook already settled (data or error) shows that outcome immediately while it refetches silently (SPEC 7.2).
8. Client rejections are ApiRequestError; use toApiError(err) to get the ApiError union.

Code-review routing (art_01M4W5AWFDXPPGNHW06YWPYD3F, PASS @43e8824, 6 minor): (1) missing exports/usage-notes comment: FIXED, posted above. (2) held error outcome shown without loading on return: SKIP, known cost of the lint-driven derived-loading design (R2), recoverable via Try again or the silent refetch; documented for BC-12 in usage note 7. (3) duplicate-write check textual vs raw location.search: SKIP, only non-canonical hand-typed URLs get one canonical self-healing push, no refetch; canonical URLs (everything the UI writes) behave as commented. (4) client.test.ts:223 test name overstates: SKIP, cosmetic, the branch exercised is the one that matters. (5) isRecord defined twice: SKIP, cosmetic 3-line duplicate. (6) date day check not month-aware: SKIP, unreachable (API dates come from Go DateLayout). None warrants a fix-and-re-review cycle.

Completion (delegator): Built src/api/{types,errors,client}.ts, src/hooks/{useSearchParamsState,useListingSearch,useCities}.ts, src/format/{money,date,listing}.ts and src/test/fixtures.ts (real A1/A3 Fairfax/A7 pending rows with ranks and relevance verified against the merged BC-3 ranker, plus full SearchResponse and empty response). 193 new tests in 8 files (197 total); make check and npm run build green at 43e8824 (master c91fa7f merged). No new dependencies. SPEC edits: 7.1 clear keeps pageSize; 7.2 success comment allows page-past-end; 7.2 useListingSearch returns { state, retry } with serialized-query identity, held-result refetch without loading, hook-owned logging (dc9a446, deviation comment above). Implementation deviations from plan, all additive or tightening: extra export formatWholeNumber; extra fixture types ErrorBody/JsonResponseInit/Deferred; abort detection also checks signal.aborted; stricter URL number parsing (plain decimals only); pushed URLs keep path and hash; duplicate-write check is textual (non-canonical URLs self-heal once). Plan review PASS (7 obvious resolved, 1 evolutionary skipped); code review PASS (1 fixed, 5 minor skipped with reasons); validation N/A with vitest evidence. No follow-up tickets created. Exports and child usage notes: see the 'BC-8 shared frontend helpers' comment.
